body.name: Weak-order schedule optimization handle
body.construction: Partition the compatible schedule space by binary exceedance indicators for \(\theta_u(1,e)-\theta_u(0,e)>c\) and assignment-specific weak-order indicators for every pair of imputed outcomes entering \(T\); enforce shared potential-outcome consistency across all \(x\in\Omega\), then optimize the induced kernel tail mass on each feasible cell.
